description:
### Figure Description

**1. Overall Layout and Style**

The figure is a single-panel, conceptual diagram with a strict **square (1:1) aspect ratio** or a portrait orientation (taller than it is wide). It is designed for academic clarity with a minimalist aesthetic. The background is a solid, pure white. All text is rendered in a clean, classic serif font to ensure a professional, publication-ready appearance. Mathematical variables are italicized as is standard.

**2. Core Visual Elements: The Distributions**

The central focus of the diagram consists of two overlapping bell-shaped curves (Gaussian distributions) that occupy the middle portion of the canvas.

*   **Left Distribution ("Non-sycophantic"):** This bell curve is positioned on the left side of the figure. It is filled with a semi-transparent (35% opacity) blue (#4C72B0).
*   **Right Distribution ("Sycophantic"):** This bell curve is positioned to the right, overlapping with the first. It is filled with a semi-transparent (35% opacity) orange (#DD8452).
*   **Overlap Region:** The two distributions have a significant overlap in the center. The semi-transparent fills create a blended, darker color in this intersection, visually highlighting the area of ambiguity between the two classes.

**3. Labels and Annotations**

Text elements are strategically placed to explain the components of the diagram.

*   **Distribution Labels:** Located in the top section of the figure, directly above the peak of each respective curve.
    *   The label "**Non-sycophantic**" is written in a **bold, solid blue (#4C72B0) serif font**.
    *   The label "**Sycophantic**" is written in a **bold, solid orange (#DD8452) serif font**.
*   **Overlap Annotations:** Positioned just above the overlapping area, these labels clarify the nature of the instances within this region.
    *   On the left side of the overlap, the text "Valid revision" is written in blue (#4C72B0) in a serif font. A thin, elegant blue arrow with a small, solid arrowhead extends downwards from this text, pointing into the left portion of the overlap zone.
    *   On the right side of the overlap, the text "Capitulation" is written in orange (#DD8452) in a serif font. A thin, elegant orange arrow with a small, solid arrowhead extends downwards from this text, pointing into the right portion of the overlap zone. Both of these labels are presented on a single line.
*   **X-Axis and Label:** A thin, solid black horizontal line is drawn below the curves to represent the x-axis. Centered beneath this line is the axis label: ***d*<sub>syc</sub>** (an italicized letter 'd' with the subscript 'syc', rendered in a serif font).
*   **Bottom Annotations:** In the bottom-most section of the figure, separated from the x-axis by a clear band of whitespace, are two key metrics.
    *   Aligned to the bottom left is the text "**AUROC = 0.83**" in a **bold, black serif font**.
    *   Aligned to the bottom right is the text "*Indistinguishable along d<sub>syc</sub>*" in an *italicized, dark gray (#555555) serif font*.

**4. Composition and Styling Details**

*   **Aspect Ratio:** The image must be square or portrait. The width must not exceed the height.
*   **Palette:** The color scheme is limited to blue (#4C72B0) and orange (#DD8452) for the distributions, complemented by neutral black and dark gray (#555555) for text and axes, all set against a pure white background.
*   **Lines:** All lines, including the x-axis and the annotation arrows, are thin and crisp. Arrows terminate in small, filled arrowheads for a clean, professional look. There are no gridlines, panel labels, or a figure title.
*   **Vertical Structure:** The layout is intentionally proportioned: the top ~15% contains the distribution labels and whitespace; the middle ~45% contains the curves and their overlap annotations; the next ~10% contains the x-axis; followed by ~10% whitespace; and the final ~20% at the bottom contains the AUROC and indistinguishability annotations. This creates a clear visual hierarchy.
